items.name: agent-run-card
items.title: Agent Run Card
items.description: Status card for one agent run: current step, live timer, model, segmented progress, finished steps and pause / stop / open controls.
items.author: jju1s <https://github.com/cig13zs>

items.name: tool-timeline
items.title: Tool Timeline
items.description: Streaming list of tool calls with an icon per kind, live durations, expandable output and an error state.
items.author: jju1s <https://github.com/cig13zs>

items.name: approval-prompt
items.title: Approval Prompt
items.description: Asks the user to allow once, always allow or deny a command or edit, styled by risk level, with Y / A / N shortcuts.
items.author: jju1s <https://github.com/cig13zs>

items.name: subagent-tree
items.title: Subagent Tree
items.description: Nested, collapsible tree of parallel subagents with live status, activity and timers. Full arrow-key navigation.
items.author: jju1s <https://github.com/cig13zs>

items.name: usage-meter
items.title: Usage Meter
items.description: Tokens in and out, cache hits, cost and percent of a rate limit with a reset countdown. Compact and expanded variants.
items.author: jju1s <https://github.com/cig13zs>

items.name: diff-summary
items.title: Diff Summary
items.description: Files changed with +/- counts and diffstat blocks; each row expands into a mini diff with line numbers.
items.author: jju1s <https://github.com/cig13zs>

items.name: use-agent-run
items.title: useAgentRun
items.description: Headless hook that turns a stream of agent-ui events into props for every component. Includes the event types and a pure reducer.
items.author: jju1s <https://github.com/cig13zs>

items.name: agent-run-ai-sdk
items.title: AI SDK adapter
items.description: Turns Vercel AI SDK useChat messages into agent-ui events.
items.author: jju1s <https://github.com/cig13zs>

items.name: agent-run-anthropic
items.title: Claude stream adapter
items.description: Turns raw Claude Messages API stream events into agent-ui events.
items.author: jju1s <https://github.com/cig13zs>

items.name: agent-run-openai
items.title: OpenAI stream adapter
items.description: Turns OpenAI Chat Completions chunks or Responses API events into agent-ui events.
items.author: jju1s <https://github.com/cig13zs>

items.name: agent-ui
items.title: agent-ui (everything)
items.description: All six components and the useAgentRun hook.
items.author: jju1s <https://github.com/cig13zs>
